Foreign main depth, stopped batch, invalid rectangles, missing owned D32 and unproved stencil dependencies veto the native frame but never change the original D3D9 Clear/gamepad/FFB.

acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Wrong owner, missing depth, stopped batch or malformed rectangles reject native frame without bypassing original D3D9 clear.
